chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The passive sodomist, his Penalty (Hadd) is the Penalty (Hadd) of the adulterer.
ai.seo_question: What is the Hadd penalty for the passive partner in sodomy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes that the passive partner in sodomy (al-malut) receives the same hadd penalty as the adulterer (al-zani), a ruling central to Shia fiqh. While some jurists debate whether this implies stoning or flogging based on whether the partner is married or unmarried, the hadith firmly links the act to the broader category of zina. It highlights the jurisprudential principle of equating the passive role with the active role in determining the severity of the punishment.
